mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.5pp in the past month) signals an imminent monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a weakening consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE declining > 0.2pp in 1 month) signals improving labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when UNRATE declines > 0.2pp in high unemployment regimes, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (a 5% drop from the 2017 base) signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 95.0, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which triggers a risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and GDPC1 decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 5.0%), a monthly increase in CPIAUCSL above 0.5% signals an accelerating inflation trend, prompting the Fed to tighten policy, which depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances in high inflation regimes, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
